What is “flat lay” photography?

Photographing flat objects, or “Flat lay” in English, is a technique that differs from the traditional packshot. This visual approach, taken in bird's eye view, allows you to create artistic compositions that highlight your products from a unique and attractive angle. Popularized on Instagram thanks to lifestyle influencers, this trend has become essential for brands who want to boost their visual presence online.

Why adopt the flat lay for your products?

‍

‍

A powerful storytelling tool

For brands, this technique offers the opportunity to Tell a visual story captivating. The possibilities are endless:

  • Presentation of Thematic boxes Of clothes
  • Staging offashion accessories Complementary
  • Creation of custom compositions by virtual personal shoppers
  • Elaboration of a “Wish list” Seasonal

Outstanding versatility

The flat lay is perfectly suited to many product categories:

  • Fashion clothing and accessories
  • Cosmetics and beauty products
  • Decorative objects
  • Electronic items
  • Table arts

Advantages of professional flat lay

A shooting carried out in a studio with adapted equipment makes it possible to obtain:

  • One pure white background Who highlights the products
  • One faithful color rendering thanks to a controlled light environment
  • Of natural drop shadows To give relief to objects

How to make successful flat lay photographs

Essential techniques

Making professional-quality flat lays requires following certain rules:

  1. Precise placement : Each element must be carefully positioned in the frame, with particular attention to the geometry of the composition.
  2. Adapted framing : Allow a margin around your topics to make it easier to reframe later.
  3. Optimized lighting : Use lighting that can reproduce a temperature close to natural light for an authentic look.

Recommended equipment

For truly professional results, forget the smartphone or the home studio:

  • Light table with camera positioned high up and parallel to the stand
  • Automated solutions like theAlphatable Or theAlphadesk from Orbitvu
  • Lighting system that faithfully reproduces daylight

The limits of the flat lay you need to know

Despite its numerous advantages, this technique has some limitations:

  • Unsuitable for large clothes Like wedding dresses
  • Does not highlight the drape or drape of the fabrics (In this case prefer a photo of the garment worn)

Conclusion

The flat lay photograph represents a innovative visual solution that combines creativity and efficiency for your e-commerce. Thanks to modern technologies offered by specialists like Orbitvu, this technique is becoming accessible and allows you to quickly produce attractive visuals that capture the attention of your potential customers.

Whether you want to enrich your presence on social networks or optimize your product sheets, flat lay is a undeniable marketing asset to distinguish your brand in an increasingly competitive digital environment.

faqs.question: What exactly is flat lay photography?
faqs.answer: Flat lay photography is a technique for shooting from above where objects are arranged flat on a surface. This method makes it possible to create attractive visual compositions seen from above, which are particularly effective for presenting products in e-commerce. It offers a unique perspective that highlights product details and allows for a coherent visual story to be told.

faqs.question: What types of products are best suited for flat lay photography?
faqs.answer: Lightweight clothing such as T-shirts, shirts, skirts, and fashion accessories work particularly well in a flat lay. Cosmetics, jewelry, tech accessories, stationery and small decorative objects are also perfect for this technique. In general, any product that is not too thick and that can be aesthetically presented flat is suitable for this approach.

faqs.question: What equipment is needed to start flat lay photography?
faqs.answer: To start simply, you will need a camera with a good resolution (or a recent smartphone with a good sensor), a neutral flat surface as a background, and homogeneous lighting. For professional results, a system like the Orbitvu Alphatable, including a light table, controlled lighting, and a camera attached perpendicularly above the surface, is recommended.

faqs.question: How do I effectively remove the background from my flat lay photos?
faqs.answer: Manual methods include using selection tools in Photoshop such as the magic wand or object selection. For a faster and more accurate process, automated systems like those from Orbitvu incorporate clipping technology that automatically identifies product contours and removes the background, while maintaining the natural shadows that are needed.

faqs.question: How do I choose between a mannequin and the flat lay to present my clothes?
faqs.answer: Opt for flat lay when you want to highlight patterns, fabrics and design details like buttons or pockets. This technique is ideal for flat garments like T-shirts, shirts, or jeans. Choose a live model when the cut, fit, or fit of the garment are essential aspects to communicate, such as for dresses, suits, or loose clothing.
